title: Spiro Drossos - Boundaries & Business Growth
summary: Welcome to Episode 132 of The Numbers Game. Today we're joined by Spiro Drossos, Managing Director of Barry Plant Eastern Group. We discuss Melbourne's evolving property market, the effects of interest rate hikes, and the vital role of client relationships. Spiro also shares insights on team training and the leap from being a salesperson to a business owner.

title: Intelligence vs Smarts
summary: Welcome to Episode 133 of The Numbers Game. In this episode, we dive into the difference between intelligence and smarts and why balancing both is key for success in business and life.

title: Challenging The Idea Of Retirement
summary: Welcome to episode 134 of The Numbers Game. On today's show we unpack the longevity secrets in the Netflix documentary "Live to 100: Secrets of the Blue Zones." We explore how these principles could be implemented in our own lives and challenge the idea of retirement, considering more enriching alternatives.

title: Marty's 12 Questions for Business Buyers
summary: Welcome to Episode 135 of The Numbers Game. In this episode, Marty breaks down the 12 essential questions you need to ask when considering buying a small business. From crunching the financial numbers to analysing industry trends, Marty shares a comprehensive guide that will arm you with the knowledge and insights you need for a successful business acquisition.

title: Navigating Growth and Profitability
summary: Welcome to Episode 136 of The Numbers Game. Today, we dissect Uber's ambitious plans to evolve into a super travel app and draw learnings on balancing growth with profitability and optimising businesses for a successful exit.

title: Building Businesses with Integrity
summary: Welcome to episode 137 of The Numbers Game. On today's show we chat about building businesses with integrity. We explore how maintaining high ethical and moral standards can shape industries and attract the right clientele.
